meta.name: mass-ulw
meta.description: Run a dependency graph of child agents in one call with the native workflow tool. Use when the user asks for mass-ulw, a DAG of tasks, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 一次调用让多个AI助手按依赖关系协同作业
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你有需要分步完成、且步骤间有先后依赖的复杂任务。
copy.tagline_en: Run dependent AI subtasks together in a single workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a big task that can be split into dependent subtasks.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会把你的请求拆成有依赖关系的子任务图,按依赖顺序分波并行调度多个子代理;每个节点自带指令、类别和可选的依赖项。执行前它必读规划文档并登记目标与验证标准,运行中可对单个节点重试、发消息或修改后重跑。
howto.when: 当你说出 mass-ulw、任务 DAG、扇出/扇入等,或要求做多代理执行且部分任务需等其它任务先完成时触发。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 把“审查文档→重写→校验”做成依赖图,依次执行。
say.note: Claude 会按阶段拆分节点并运行。

say.text: 帮我把三个子任务排成 DAG:A 先跑,等它完成后再并行跑 B 和 C。
say.note: 它会按依赖顺序分波并行执行。

say.text: 用 mass-ulw 跑一次工作流:先审查代码,再写测试,测试通过后补文档。
say.note: 每个节点会等前置节点完成。

howto.what_en: Claude turns the request into a dependency graph of child-agent tasks and runs them in waves in dependency order. It reads the planning doc, sets a goal with verification, and can retry, message, or amend individual nodes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions "mass-ulw", a task DAG, fan-out/fan-in work, or multi-agent execution where some tasks must wait on others.

say_en.text: Use mass-ulw to turn 'audit -> rewrite -> verify' into a dependency graph and run it.
say_en.note: Claude splits it into staged nodes and runs them.

say_en.text: Make a DAG of three subtasks: run A first, then run B and C in parallel once A finishes.
Run a mass-ulw workflow: audit the code, write tests, then update docs after tests pass.
say_en.note: Each node waits for its dependencies.
